name: EmbodiedVerse-Bench
description: A benchmark suite for embodied AI that measures an agent's ability to navigate, follow instructions, and interact with objects in simulated 3D environments. It contains tasks emphasizing embodied perception, long-horizon planning, and instruction-conditioned behavior to evaluate both perception and control in realistic embodied settings. The benchmark focuses on task completion and robustness to varied environment layouts.
reputation: Relatively new and specialized benchmark from the FlagEval group with limited adoption so far in the embodied-AI community.
